name: @wasm-gaming/snes9x-wasm
description: Snes9x (Super Nintendo / Super Famicom emulator) compiled to WebAssembly via Emscripten, with a JS SDK conforming to the wasm-gaming engine contract.
comment:scripts: Build logic lives in the Makefile, not here (make build / build-sdk / build-wasm / preview).
comment:dependencies: engine-specs is the one wasm-gaming package an engine depends on. Its runtime is also copied into dist/snes9x/ and imported relatively, so the built SDK loads without a bundler or an import map; the dependency carries the types.
